scenario: 今天这条赛道讲的是把用户信号用准、把算力花得更值。SepLRM 把长序列编码从各个排序模型里拆出来共用，Wayfair 在搜索广告里同时按候选商品和 query 从长期历史中检索行为。Airbnb 在封面图实验里发现，先按搜索意图收窄候选，比单纯推高点击率更能带来预订。UAPM 把还没定论的行为解读留在用户画像之外，等后续证据再决定怎么写。Meta 的 Your Algorithm 让用户用自己的话告诉系统想看什么，并把这些偏好接进从召回到设备端的整条链路。

papers.title: SepLRM: A Foundation Model Paradigm for Recommendation
papers.authors: Di Chen, Xijun Xiao, Qin Ren, Weijiang Lai, Zhijian Pan, Zhentao Pan, Pengfei Nie, Cheng Yuan, Zixuan Tan, Xuyang Liu, Tao Wang, Yunwen Huang, Hao Fang, Yichao Wang, Hao Zhang, Siyuan Wu, Hao Chen, Han Diao, Mingyu Yang, Yongkang Feng, Beihong Jin, Jinfeng Yang, Deping Xie, Peng Xu, Zheng Chai, Yuchao Zheng
papers.abstract: Large recommendation models (LRMs) improve recommendation performance by scaling behavior sequence length, model capacity, and training compute. However, the return on investment (ROI) of continued scaling deteriorates as marginal gains diminish and long-sequence encoding costs rise, especially when this computation is repeatedly executed by distinct models for diverse recommendation stages and business scenarios. To address this issue, we propose SepLRM, a recommendation foundation model (RFM) paradigm that identifies reusable sequence encoding and reorganizes multiple end-to-end (E2E) LRMs into one RFM and multiple independently optimized vertical models (VMs). The RFM adopts an encoder-decoder architecture and exports its final-layer encoder state as the shared key-value (KV) cache that is independent of downstream task-offered candidates. Unlike candidate-specific logits or aggregated user embeddings, the KV cache preserves fine-grained behavioral information. Separation at this native KV interface also allows each VM to construct candidate-conditioned queries while retaining the same query-KV interaction as its E2E counterpart, enabling high-fidelity capability transfer. To ensure both transfer effectiveness and system efficiency, we co-design cache compression, the training and serving workflows, and LG-Store, a distributed storage system for KV caches. Experiments on three large-scale datasets show that SepLRM achieves state-of-the-art offline performance with a transfer rate of approximately 100%. It also demonstrates strong transferability across model iterations, recommendation stages, and business scenarios. Deployment in two large-scale industrial scenarios substantially improves the ROI of sequence scaling and delivers consistent gains in online A/B tests at ByteDance.
papers.summary: 推荐系统里，不同阶段和业务的模型都在把同一份用户长序列各编码一遍，序列越长，这笔重复开销越不划算。SepLRM 把编码这一步拆出来：一个共享的基础模型跑 encoder，把最后一层对每条行为的表示存成 KV cache，下游各模型用自己的候选和上下文构造 query，再用交叉注意力去查这份 cache。切口选在 encoder 和 decoder 之间，下游的计算方式就和端到端模型一样，不压缩时长序列带来的 AUC 提升约 100% 保留下来。==基础模型自己的 AUC 高，不代表它导出的 cache 好用==，只有 encoder 或只有 decoder 的版本 AUC 几乎不变，下游保留率却掉到九成左右。线上在广告和电商两个场景，ROI 分别是同规模端到端模型的 8.62 倍和 2.62 倍。

papers.title: Proactive Dimension-Adaptive Denoising for Graph Collaborative Filtering via Representation Coherence
papers.authors: Wenjun Li, Dong Zhao, Jiaying Shi, Juan Zhang, Zhaoming Pan, Zhimin Zhang
papers.abstract: Implicit feedback in recommender systems contains noisy interactions (e.g., accidental clicks, impulse purchases) that propagate through user-item graphs and contaminate learned representations. Existing explicit denoising methods uniformly rely on training loss to estimate interaction reliability. However, loss is a fundamentally passive signal: it detects noise only after it has caused prediction errors, and it is heavily confounded by training stage, negative sampling, and hard positives. We propose Noise-aware Dimension Learning (NDL), a proactive dimension-adaptive denoising framework. NDL introduces Representation Coherence Detection (RCD), which evaluates the coherence between an interaction representation and the user's historical preference centroid in embedding space, providing an active noise signal independent of loss. RCD and the loss signal are fused via activity-aware weighting (active users rely more on coherence while cold-start users automatically fall back to loss), and the fused estimate drives an interaction-level dimension-adaptive mask that limits the effective representation capacity of unreliable interactions. A lightweight contrastive regularizer further improves embedding uniformity, stabilizing the geometry on which RCD discriminates. On three public benchmarks NDL consistently outperforms state-of-the-art denoising methods, lifting Recall@5 by +17.95% on Amazon-book, +12.33% on Yelp, and +5.63% on MovieLens-1M over the strongest baseline DAR; the core variant without contrastive learning already surpasses DAR on sparser datasets, confirming representation coherence as the primary driver of these gains. NDL is confined to the training loop and is serving-compatible with LightGCN-based production pipelines, adding no online latency or parameters at inference time. Code: https://github.com/GordonDongZHAO/NDL
papers.summary: 隐式反馈去噪几乎都靠训练损失判断哪条交互是噪声，可损失要等模型被带偏以后才变大，还受负采样和训练阶段干扰。网易的 NDL 加了一个新信号：算这条交互的表示和该用户历史交互平均表示的余弦相似度，偏离越大越可疑，==这个信号不用等模型预测出错就能给出==。活跃用户主要信这个信号，冷启动用户退回训练损失。融合后的可疑分决定这条交互能用多少 embedding 维度，越可疑用得越少。在评分低于三分算噪声的公开数据上，Recall@5 比最强基线 DAR 高 5.63% 到 17.95%，数据越稀疏提升越大。改动只在训练环节，线上仍是原来形状的 LightGCN embedding，不过这套方法还没有上线。

papers.title: OptiCover: A Scalable and Multi-Surface Framework for Cold-Start Visual Optimization under Semantic Constraints
papers.authors: Guillaume Guy, Mihajlo Grbovic, Joe Mills, Selen Uguroglu, Liwei He, Pratiksha Kadam, Nalini Kartha, Qian Aria Li
papers.abstract: Selecting an effective cover photo is a critical yet understudied problem in visual merchandising for e-commerce marketplaces. On Airbnb, hosts upload many photos depicting different rooms, amenities, and points of interest, but must manually choose a single static cover photo that is reused across heterogeneous product surfaces. This creates substantial challenges: over 90\% of listing photos have no engagement labels, leading to a severe cold-start regime; guest preferences vary across surfaces and search intents, and visually captivating photos may be semantically misaligned with the underlying listing. At Airbnb scale, this corresponds to hundreds of millions of photos and hundreds of thousands of new uploads per day. We propose \emph{OptiCover}, a scalable framework for cold-start visual optimization under semantic constraints and multi-surface engagement signals. The framework combines (i) a photo candidate generator that identifies candidate photos through various proxies, (ii) lightweight vision heads applied to frozen CLIP embeddings for large-scale semantic scoring, (iii) a cross-modal grounding validator based on a vision-language model (VLM) that enforces semantic representativeness, and (iv) an Exploration Logging Module (ELM) that orchestrates the collection of randomized engagement data across heterogeneous product surfaces and contextual search intents. We evaluate OptiCover through extensive offline studies and multiple online experiments across HomePage, and Search surfaces. OptiCover is now deployed in production and performs tens of millions of photo swaps daily. Online results show a 1.5\% engagement lift on the HomePage and a 0.35\% increase in bookers on Search, generating millions of dollars in incremental revenue. Our findings suggest that action-space shaping and semantic constraints are primary drivers of performance.
papers.summary: Airbnb 想替房东挑封面图，可超过 90% 的房源照片从没当过封面，没有点击数据可学。作者先用几类间接线索筛出候选图，用 VLM 核对照片确实能代表这套房源，再按预测 CTR 选图，首页 A/B 的 CTR 提高 1.5%。最有意思的是搜索页的两组实验。直接选预测点击最高的图，CTR 显著上涨，预订人数却没有显著变化，分析发现多出来的点击主要是把预订从一个房源挪到另一个房源。先按用户的筛选条件（比如泳池）收窄候选再选图，CTR 没有显著变化，预订人数却显著提高 0.35%。==在搜索页，按用户意图收窄候选比推高点击率更能带来预订==。

papers.title: Query- and Candidate-Aware Long User Sequence Modeling for Sponsored Product Ranking in Search
papers.authors: Dongyue Xie, Sergey Kolbin, Manavender Malgireddy, Iurii Shcherbak, Weixing Tang, Arushi Jain, Wanchen Shao, Kurt Zimmer, Raja Hafiz Affandi, Matt Lindsay
papers.abstract: User sequence modeling is widely used in recommendation and advertising. Search ranking presents an additional challenge: the current query expresses immediate intent, while a candidate product determines which parts of a user's long-term history are relevant. We present a production sequence framework for sponsored-product ranking that augments recent behavior with two retrieval channels over long-term history: candidate-nearest-neighbor retrieval and query-nearest-neighbor retrieval. The selected actions are encoded together with dedicated query and candidate context tokens, while candidate-aware early fusion injects the candidate into every history token. Offline ablations show that dual retrieval improves major ranking metrics relative to the production baseline. In an online A/B test on sponsored-product search traffic, the model increased CTR, attributed conversion rate, and orders per impression.
papers.summary: 搜索广告排序用长期行为时，常见做法是拿候选商品去历史里找相似行为，可用户当前的 query 也在说明哪些历史有用。Wayfair 在最近行为之外，从长期历史里按候选和按 query 各检索一批行为，再连同 query 和候选两个上下文 token 一起送进 Transformer。离线看，两路检索合起来的 AUC 增益高于任何单路，说明它们找到的历史互相补充。另一个发现是，把候选信息拼进每条历史行为这一步不能省，去掉后模型比线上基线明显更差，==只靠一个全局的候选 token 再间接交互补不回来==。整套模型的线上 A/B 中，CTR 提高 6.0%，每次曝光的订单数提高 11.5%，模型服务延迟增加约 12%。

papers.title: Slim Foundation Models for Latency-Critical Recommendation Serving
papers.authors: Danyal Aftab, Anas Zafar, Assadig Abakr, Steven Davy
papers.abstract: Click-through rate (CTR) prediction is a core component of recommendation and advertising systems. Large language models (LLMs) offer rich semantic priors that improve prediction quality, particularly in cold-start and long-tail settings. Injecting a full-scale LLM into a CTR pipeline is, however, prohibitively expensive at inference time: existing LLM-enhanced CTR methods avoid this cost by caching LLM outputs offline rather than serving the LLM online. We propose a resource-efficient pipeline, SlimFM, that makes online LLM-based semantic modeling practical: (1) dependency-aware structured pruning compresses LLaMA3-8B by 44% to a 4.5B-parameter backbone; (2) LoRA-based field-aware fine-tuning trains the pruned model to produce discriminative field-level semantic embeddings from lightweight textual prompts; (3) a semantic-guided fusion module injects these embeddings into the feature interactions of a conventional CTR model. Across four datasets and six CTR backbones, SlimFM retains over 99% of uncompressed-model accuracy while reducing inference latency by up to 3.4x relative to existing LLM-enhanced baselines.
papers.summary: 把大模型放进 CTR 在线链路太贵，现有方法大多把大模型输出离线算好存起来，物品或特征库一变就得重算。SlimFM 想让大模型直接在线跑，先对 LLaMA3 做结构化剪枝，砍掉 44% 的参数。再用 LoRA 微调，让模型给每个特征字段（比如 MovieID）产出一个 embedding，字段之间的相似度用来给 CTR 模型的特征交叉重新加权。在 FM 上，剪枝后的平均 AUC 仍有完整模型的 99.77%，推理比现有的大模型增强方法最多快 3.4 倍。准确率上它没有明显领先，在不到一半的模型和数据集组合里拿到几种大模型增强方法中的最高 AUC，==它的主要价值在延迟==。

papers.title: CHO-Bench: How Do Context Hints Affect Ad Rankings in LLM Advertising?
papers.authors: Shiqi Zhang, Yang Fei, Xiaokui Xiao
papers.abstract: LLM advertising selects advertisements based on user conversations, where user needs may extend beyond explicit product searches. ChatGPT Ads allows advertisers to provide natural-language context hints describing what they offer, who may find it useful, and when it may be useful, as additional information for ranking advertisements across diverse user conversations. However, how to effectively construct these hints remains unclear. We formulate Context Hint Optimization (CHO) as the problem of constructing context hints to improve an advertisement's ranking under a given budget. Drawing on established marketing frameworks, we develop seven context hint generation strategies covering What, Who, and When, along with a Unified strategy that combines all seven dimensions. We introduce CHO-Bench and conduct over 1.19 million paired evaluations across five datasets using embedding-based and LLM-based rankers. Our results show that context hints improve advertisement rankings under the evaluated offline rankers. While individual strategies achieve similar average gains and Unified offers no consistent advantage, strategy differences become more pronounced under specific generation-ranking configurations, with embedding-based and LLM-based rankers favoring different information dimensions. Increasing the hint budget further improves rankings with diminishing marginal gains. These findings establish an offline benchmark for studying ad-side ranking optimization in LLM advertising and highlight opportunities for model-specific hint selection and budget-aware generation and aggregation.
papers.summary: ChatGPT Ads 允许广告主写自然语言提示，说明产品是什么、适合谁、什么时候用，这些提示用于广告排序，和展示给用户的广告卡片分开。提示到底该怎么写？作者按营销学框架拆成七种写法，再加一种全部混合，做了超过 119 万次有提示和无提示的成对比较。加提示平均能让广告前进 0.56 到 1.16 位，但七种写法差别很小，全部混合也没有稳定占优。按排名提升看，差别出现在排序器上：embedding 排序器偏向描述使用场景的提示，LLM 排序器偏向描述目标人群的提示。提示条数增加一般还能继续提升排名，但边际收益递减。实验里只有被测广告加了提示，用的也是离线排序器，竞品都写提示后的效果还要另看。

papers.title: Not Yet in the Profile: Uncertainty-Aware Dynamic User Profiling by Learning from Future Interactions
papers.authors: Jieyong Kim, Neil Shah, Dong Wang
papers.abstract: On the Web, user profiling builds compact user representations from interaction histories for efficient personalization, and dynamic user profiling updates them as users' behavior and preferences change. However, new user behavior can be ambiguous, and its interpretation differs across users. To address this, we introduce Uncertainty-aware Adaptive Profile Manager (UAPM), which separates the claims in a user profile from interpretations of new behavior that are not yet confirmed, through a Profile, a Buffer, and a Rulebook. UAPM records user-specific interpretation and update rules in the Rulebook, keeps ambiguous evidence in the Buffer outside the Profile as evidence for later decisions, and writes supported general and situational characteristics to the Profile. We train UAPM with Privileged On-Policy Distillation with Dual Specialization (POPD-DS), which learns from recorded future interactions during training without access to them at deployment. Its first stage, Dual Specialization, distills a stronger model into a current-only Student and a future-informed model that becomes the Teacher. In the second stage, privileged on-policy distillation (POPD), only the fixed Teacher receives future interactions and guides the Student's own management decisions alongside task rewards. Experiments on three Web personalization tasks show that UAPM outperforms multiple baselines under the same downstream input budget, improving on the best same-budget baseline by up to 5%.
papers.summary: 用大模型维护用户画像时，新行为常常有多种解读：奇幻迷给一本奇幻绘画教程打了 3 分，可能是对奇幻腻了，也可能只是不喜欢绘画教程。现有方法只能马上写进画像或者丢掉，写错了就持续误导后面的预测。UAPM 在画像之外加两块下游模型读不到的存储，一块暂存还没定论的解读和相关证据，一块记录这个用户需要什么证据才下结论。训练时，一个看得到用户未来行为的教师模型指导学生模型的每步决策，部署时学生模型只用当前信息。同样的画像长度下，它比最好的基线最多提升 5%，去掉任何一块存储几乎所有指标都变差。==暂存内容很少直接转进画像，主要作为后续修改画像的证据==。

papers.abstract:
Your algorithm is a suite of AI-powered tools that makes Facebook recommendations more transparent and steerable, with a single editable view of the interests that shape Feed and Reels. We’re sharing how Your algorithm turns people’s natural language preferences into responsive recommendations, and how LLMs are tailored to specific tasks within the system. Traditionally, the [...]

Read More...

The post Your Algorithm: Giving People More Ways to Personalize Facebook Recommendations appeared first on Engineering at Meta.
papers.summary: Facebook 的推荐长期靠隐式行为学习，变化慢，也抓不住细微偏好。Your Algorithm 让用户用自己的话写想看和不想看什么，难点在于让这句话真的改变推荐。每个想看的兴趣都有四路专门召回，==没有专门召回，新兴趣的内容可能根本进不了排序==。候选通过相关性检查后在后期排序里获得加权，再由重排控制间隔和每日上限，免得刷屏。不想看的兴趣分层拦截：排序阶段用 embedding 比较来过滤，排完由微调过的 LLM 再审一遍列表，设备端丢掉已缓存的匹配内容。团队发现，把小模型微调成只输出该删的条目，比通用模型逐条判断更快也更可靠。

papers.title: An Adaptive, Context-Aware, and Stacked Attention Network-Based Recommendation System to Capture Users' Temporal Preference
papers.authors: Jung-Hsien Chiang, Chung-Yao Ma, Chi-Shiang Wang, Pei-Yi Hao
papers.abstract: Recommendation systems have become more important since the widespread use of the Internet. The large amount of information means that it is difficult for users to discover they really need. However, users' preferences can change over time because of the age and the impact of social networks. Recommendation systems must capture users' preferences and recommend suitable items, which is a difficult challenge. This study proposes a novel recommendation system that adapts to the changing preferences of users. By learning and adapting to users' changing preferences better recommendations are provided. This study uses context factors as additional information to model users' preferences more precisely. For the proposed recommendation system, the context is based on users' interaction items within each defined time interval. This study proposes two novel attention mechanisms for the recommendation system. The contextual item attention module captures contextual information, changing pattern in users' preference and the importance of items. The multi-head attention module extends the diversity of users' preferences and adapts to changing preferences. The recommendation performance is improved using additional item's temporal information to model the contextual item's representation. Experiments compare the proposed algorithm with several state-of-the-art recommendation methods using three real-world datasets. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed context-aware recommendation model outperforms traditional methods and demonstrate the effectiveness with which contextual information is captured by the attention mechanism.
papers.summary: 用户口味会随时间变，序列模型又容易只盯着最近几次点击、丢掉长期兴趣。这篇 2023 年发表在 TKDE 的论文用两个注意力模块处理这件事。第一个用用户 embedding 给最近一个时间窗口内的物品打权重，汇总成当前上下文。第二个把用户 embedding 投影到多个空间，每个空间代表口味的一个方面，由当前上下文决定各方面的权重。论文报告 HR@10 相对最强基线提升 3.25%，但提升很不均匀，Pinterest 上只比 SASRec 高 0.32%。消融实验说明结构要按数据调：多堆几层影响不大，加位置编码在 Pinterest 上反而略差。评测时测试物品只和随机抽样的负样本比排名，读数字时要记住这一点。

papers.title: UCB-min: Combining Bandits Under Variance Heterogeneity (Extended Version)
papers.authors: Lilia Izri, Benoit Groz, Silviu Maniu
papers.abstract: Multi-armed bandits are a natural framework for many real-world sequential decision problems, from recommender systems and clinical trials to educational test recommendation and online advertising. The performance of these algorithms depends on how they explore different arms, and exploration strategies range from variance-independent (e.g., UCB1) to variance-aware (e.g., UCB-V). In practice the reward variance of each arm is rarely known and varies widely across arms, and the reward support is often underspecified. In these cases no single rule is uniformly best: variance-independent methods are robust but loose when variances are small, while variance-aware methods are tight only when their variance estimates and the assumed support bound are reliable. Such heterogeneous, unknown variances arise in many settings, for instance when multiple objectives are scalarized into a single reward. We propose UCB-min, a per-arm adaptive meta-algorithm that selects, for each arm, the tighter of a variance-independent and a variance-aware exploration bonus, without prior knowledge of the variance regime and without reward normalization. We prove that, with UCB-V as variance-aware base, its regret is bounded by the sum of the two base bounds at the standard exploration constant, and by their per-arm minimum, up to a constant, for a larger one. We validate it on synthetic data, an educational tutoring task, and two group-recommendation benchmarks (MovieLens, Steam), showing that UCB-min consistently tracks the best base algorithm across diverse variance regimes and datasets.
papers.summary: 多目标推荐把相关性、分歧这些指标加权成一个奖励后，不同候选的方差可能差很多，于是 UCB1 这类不看方差的探索和 UCB-V 这类看方差的探索，谁好要看数据。UCB-min 的做法很简单：每一轮给每个候选算两种探索加分，取小的那个。在 MovieLens 群组推荐上，方差大，UCB-V2 过度探索，累积遗憾 406，UCB-min 跟着 UCB1 停在 233；在方差小的 Steam 上，它又跟上了 UCB-V2。==不用预先知道方差情况，也不用归一化奖励，只多算一个加分==。需要留意，实验主要使用的 UCB-minV2 目前没有理论保证，Steam 上 UCB1-Tuned 的遗憾也更低。
